text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's popularity was skyrocketing 
with the public. Right around that time, 
that certain junior Umamusume appeared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said that thanks to Fuji Kiseki, she 
realized something important. However, 
Fuji Kiseki seemed to have mixed feelings 
about those words...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That junior isn't the only Umamusume 
shackled by distance aptitude... With that 
in mind, Fuji Kiseki sets a new goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I will conquer GⅠ races across four 
different distance aptitudes!" ...So she 
proclaims!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer agrees with her feelings. This 
goal was widely reported, sparking immense 
excitement across the public—!
